title: Ceviche Skewer Appetizer
description: A keto-friendly appetizer that combines the freshness of ceviche with the smokiness of roasted avocado, all on a stick.

ingredients.name: Oozy cheese (optional)
ingredients.notes: For keto compliance, use a low-carb cheese

instructions: 2. Cut the avocado in half and place it on a baking sheet. Roast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender.
3. Cut the fish into bite-sized pieces and place them in a large bowl.
4. Squeeze the lime juice over the fish, making sure it's all coated.
5. Stir in the chopped cilantro and salt to taste.
6. Thread a piece of fish, a roasted avocado slice, and a sprinkle of cilantro onto each skewer.
7. If using, sprinkle a small amount of oozy cheese on top of the fish.
8. Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
